headline: Alexandru Nazare sounds alarm on reducing budget deficit: "The bridge behind us is broken, there is only forward"
summary: Interim Finance Minister Alexandru Nazare said Romania has covered about half the distance to reducing its budget deficit. He warned that "the bridge behind us is broken, there is only forward".
why: Budget deficit reduction determines Romania's borrowing needs and sovereign credit standing, which shape government bond yields and investor confidence in the country.

original_headline: Alexandru Nazare trage un semnal de alarmă privind reducerea deficitului bugetar: „Podul în spate e rupt, nu există decât înainte”
